name: CSS declarations read without temporary copies

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## CSS declarations read without temporary copies Hypothesis

Reading declarations (every rule's block and every `style` attribute) copied the text to take its comments out, comments or not, and lowercased a copy of each value to find `!important`. Text without comments is read as it is, and `!important` is found in the value itself, in any case.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** no temporary copies in declaration reading. **Allowed:** svg `css.rs` strip_comments, parse_declarations; a css_selectors test. **Forbidden:** the grammar.
